name: Commerce Qliro Checkout
description: Provides Drupal Commerce integration for Qliro One / Qliro Checkout, the Nordic hosted-checkout payment provider, as an off-site payment gateway. Renders Qliro's embedded checkout HTML snippet (fetched from Qliro's authenticated Merchant API), acknowledges/completes orders from Qliro's server-side API on the checkout-status push and browser return, and supports manual capture, void (cancel) and refunds via Qliro's Admin API. Built on the iqv/qliro_php_sdk PHP SDK.
project_description:
Payment module for Drupal Commerce using Qliro Checkout
